cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL: conveys that multiple frames are concatenated / sent in one transmission (and ideally without releasing the channel / shared medium control).
acceptable_variants: sending a sequence of frames without releasing the channel
transmitting multiple frames in one go to reduce overhead
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: PARTIAL (0.75): vague mention of bursting/sending multiple frames without the concatenation / single-transmission idea. ABSENT: missing or wrong.
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: Frame bursting reduces the overhead for transmitting small frames by concatenating a sequence of multiple frames in one single transmission, without ever releasing control of the channel.

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Advantage and disadvantage of frame bursting compared to carrier extension
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL (1.5): states both an advantage (e.g., higher efficiency/no padding) AND a disadvantage (e.g., delay/buffering) vs carrier extension.
acceptable_variants: more efficient than carrier extension because it avoids garbage padding
requires buffering frames which introduces latency
cqa_tuples.partial_credit_rule: PARTIAL (0.75): only advantage OR only disadvantage (one side present). ABSENT: neither side present or wrong.
cqa_tuples.source_rubric_span: 2) Advantage AND disadvantage vs carrier extension (1.5 marks) — SINGLE concept.
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: Advantage :it is more efficient than carrier extension as single frames not filled up with garbage. Disadvantage :need frames waiting for transmission or buffering and delay of frames
